scenes.name: ONE RULER PER PRIME
lines: Count by ones, and the usual ruler only stretches: two, three, four, five, six.
一步步加一，通常的尺子只会越拉越长：2、3、4、5、6。
Give every prime its own ruler: each factor p shrinks ruler p by p.
给每个素数一把尺：每个因子 p 让第 p 把尺缩小 p 倍。
Six reads one half on ruler two, one third on ruler three.
6 在 2 号尺上读 1/2，在 3 号尺上读 1/3。
The book reads primes as curvature recovering nuclei: an interpretation, not a theorem.
本书把素数读作曲率回收核：这是诠释，不是定理。

scenes.name: THE PRODUCT IS ONE
lines: Multiply the readings: six, times one half, times one third, is exactly one.
把读数乘起来：6 × 1/2 × 1/3，恰好是 1。
Thirty-one is blind to rulers two, three and five. Only ruler thirty-one answers.
31 对 2、3、5 号尺全都失明，只有 31 号尺应答。
Lean checks: for every nonzero rational, the whole product is exactly one.
Lean 内核检验：任意非零有理数，全部读数之积恰好是 1。
Under logarithms each prime is its own axis. Lean checks they are independent over the rationals.
取对数，每个素数是独立的一根轴。Lean 内核检验：它们在有理数上线性无关。

scenes.name: FIVE SPLITS
lines: Integers commute. In the whole quaternions, five splits: one plus two i, times one minus two i.
整数可以交换。到了整四元数里，5 会分裂：(1 + 2i)(1 − 2i) = 5。
Put the two on i, j or k, with either sign: six spinors.
把 2 放到 i、j 或 k 上，取正负号：得到六枚素旋子。
Lean checks each has squared norm five and fidelity one fifth.
Lean 内核检验：每一枚模方为 5，保真度为 1/5。
Each turns space about an axis: cosine minus three fifths, sine four fifths.
每一枚都绕一根轴转动：余弦 −3/5，正弦 4/5。

scenes.name: MOD FIVE
lines: Count mod five, where two squared is minus one: each spinor becomes a two by two matrix.
模 5 计算，此时 2² ≡ −1：每枚素旋子变成一个 2×2 矩阵。
One plus two i becomes a single column times a single row.
1 + 2i 变成一列乘一行。
Lean checks all six are nonzero and rank one.
Lean 内核检验：六个矩阵全都非零且秩为一。
Of the thirty-six products, exactly six vanish: a spinor followed by its inverse.
36 个乘积中恰好 6 个为零：一枚素旋子紧接它的逆。

scenes.name: NEVER HOME
lines: Chain spinors, never undoing the last: the links stay nonzero.
把素旋子连成串，从不撤销上一步：衔接处始终非零。
One plus two i, then j, then k, gives minus seven, six, minus two, six, of squared norm one hundred twenty-five.
Lean checks: every word has squared norm five to its length, and every reduced word stays nonzero mod five.
Lean 内核检验：任意词的模方是 5 的词长次方，任意既约词模 5 后仍不为零。
Mod five, five divides none of its coordinates.
模 5 后，它的坐标没有一个能被 5 整除。

scenes.name: A FREE TREE
lines: Reduced words: six of length one, thirty of length two, one hundred fifty of length three.
既约词：长度 1 有 6 个，长度 2 有 30 个，长度 3 有 150 个。
Lean checks: two reduced words that move the x and y axes alike are the same word.
Lean 内核检验：两个既约词若把 x 轴与 y 轴转到同一处，就是同一个词。
So the six spinors freely generate a group on three letters.
所以六枚素旋子自由生成一个三字母自由群。
Each gate adds half of log base two of five bits, about one point one six.
每多一个门，高度增加 ½ log₂ 5 比特，约 1.16。

scenes.name: SIX AXES
lines: The same one and two return in space: six axes of squared length five.
同样的 1 与 2 在三维空间里重现：六根模方为 5 的轴。
Around each, keep the points where twice the squared projection exceeds five.
在每根轴周围，保留投影平方的两倍超过 5 的点。
Lean checks: the six sets are open, cover the sphere, and none holds a right angle.
Lean 内核检验：六片都是开集，盖满球面，且没有一片含有直角。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Math, chapter fourteen.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第十四章
